Twenty-six comments

Maurice Lennon’s Tribute To Larry Reynolds

Maurice sent me an audio of this haunting reel, and hoped it would be a comfort to Larry’s family at this time of year without him. He has given me permission to post it here, noting that the tune is copyright to Maurice Lennon, IMRO&MCPS.
Think of Boston’s beloved musician when you play it.

↳ Posted by fiddlercjp on January 3rd, 2013.

Oh wow, that’s really cool!

↳ Posted by sebastian the m3g4p0p on January 3rd, 2013.

A Tribute To Larry Reynolds

This beautiful tune is the second in the Humours of Glenanniff set, composed and played by
Maurice Lennon on The Leitrim Equation 3 album.

Link to the liner notes by Scutcher:
https://thesession.org/recordings/4505

It rolls along nicely, a perfect companion to the Humours of Glenanniff.

↳ Posted by fiddlerdan on January 24th, 2014.

A Tribute to Larry Reynolds

Only seven of us have added this Amaj reel to our tunebooks ~ I came across it while searching for something to use with a song, and it’s ended up becoming quite popular at our local sessions. A joyful tune, fun to play, I recommend that you give it a try!

↳ Posted by Sheree Green on March 20th, 2015.

Delighted that this tune is doing the rounds!…it has been recorded on the new album by the band Lunasa and also features on a recent album by Scottish band Capercaillie. My thanks to all.Maurice.

Re: Maurice Lennon’s Tribute To Larry Reynolds

Charlie McKerron was about to launch in to teaching this at Sabhal Mòr Ostaig a few years back, but some lassie asked for another tune and he got sidetracked. He did, however, play it for the class & I had a most remarkable ringtone for many years afterwards. It’s a fabulous tune. So also are ‘If Ever you Were Mine’, ‘The Road to Garrison’ & ‘Master Shanley’s’ Thank you, Maurice.
